summary: Search, paid and social run as one programme for a fragrance brand building its own demand.
challenge: Before TDM, the brand needed stronger digital visibility, premium product presentation, and luxury-focused storytelling to stand out in the competitive perfume market.
approach: TDM aligned SEO, performance marketing, and social media strategy to sharpen the brand's brand presence. We improved discoverability, refined luxury-focused content, and created a stronger path from first impression to enquiry or sale.

testimonial.quote: TDM improved our visibility, strengthened our luxury brand storytelling, and helped us connect better with perfume customers.
testimonial.author: Fragrance retail client, Pakistan
